mu:combo.text: Repeatedly press Attack to perform a combo. Now it's your turn!

mu:down.text: Press Down + Attack to perform a low kick and stun your enemy.

mu:up.text: Press Up + Attack to perform a high kick and launch your enemy into the air.

mu:special.text: Press Forward + Special to unleash your special attack. It consumes Cosmos, so use it carefully!

mu:dash.text: Quickly press Forward twice, then Attack to perform a dash attack!

mu:charge.text: Hold Attack for five seconds, then release it to unleash a charged attack.

mu:backattack.text: Press Back + Attack to perform a back attack. Try it!

mu:uppercut.text: Press Up + Special to perform a powerful uppercut and launch your enemies into the air!

mu:ultra.text: Press Down + Special to unleash your ultimate attack. Burn your Cosmos!

mu:jump.text: Press Jump, then Attack to perform an aerial attack. Now it's your turn!

mu:end.text: Training is complete! It's time to repair your Cloths: difficult battles await you!

mu:throw.text: Grab an enemy, then press Attack to strike. Finish by pressing Forward + Attack to throw them!
